description: Send version bsd-agent-tail-v1 and action doctor_picks (today’s saved Doctor picks and recent settled results), doctor_parlays (league: the Doctor’s graded parlays for one league, e.g. LGUE_nfl, and its parlays record), feed (optional feed/profileId/listId/search/limit/cursor/gradeFamily), hot (Hot picks of the last 24 h by fire + tails; optional gradeFamily/limit) or post (postId). Read the same account-filtered Tail feed or one visible post as the BSD app. Moderation, follows, mutes, private lists and cursor binding use the app service.

gradeFamily.description: feed and hot: only posts whose letter is in this family.

league.description: doctor_parlays only: one league id, e.g. LGUE_nfl.

name: tail_read
title: Read Tail
